testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect marking-menu environments without changing selection: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:1941:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect marking-menu environments without changing selection ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the customization dialog is open on the Marking Menu tab in the MCAD Software ✔ And Environment is "2D Sketch" ✔ When the user opens the Environment selector ✔ Then the available choices include "2D Sketch", "3D Sketch", "Assembly", "Drawing", "Part", "Presentation" and "Sheet Metal" ✔ And "2D Sketch" remains selected ✔ When the user dismisses the selector without choosing an option ✔ Then Environment remains "2D Sketch" ✔ And no customization change is pending
